highlights: UGREEN 20277 4-Port USB 2.0 Hub CR106 Compatible with Windows / MaC OS & Linux
Ugreen 20277 USB 2.0 High Speed 4 port Hub allows you to connect multiple USB devices to a single USB port.
Then you connect your keyboard, mouse, camera, printer, PC fans etc on your PC at the same time. It is a USB 2.0 standard and offers data transfer rate up to 480 Mbps.
80 cm length convenient to extend your USB devices to your desk.
The hub is equipped with a triple security system. It protects the device against overvoltage, reverse current and peak current.
